verdict.rationale: The California Franchise Tax Board is a state tax authority whose records are held under its own jurisdiction. A user-selectable storage region or residency option is a category error for this kind of product, not a missing feature. The evidence pack contains only edge-denial probes (HTTP 403) and nothing showing such a capability, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
